title: Three-team Rondo
minutes: Not specified; proposed short rounds agreed with coach
equipment: Proposed: ball, boundary cones, three colours of pinnies.
setup: Attacking teams in separate halves; defenders start centrally.
instructions: Attackers combine three passes then switch to other team for a point.
Defenders steal and combine once for one point.
Defenders return ball to their start area for three points.
support: Proposed option: Reduce required passes before switch; proposed simplification.
challenge: Proposed option: Increase passing requirement or defender numbers (source progressions).
observe: Can child create a passing route before switch?
How do teams respond when possession changes?
